slides.title: Exporting Data
slides.text:
Raster to Google Drive

Use Export.image.toDrive() to download your imagery data sets.

Export.image.toDrive(\{ 
image: image, 
description: 'image’, 
region: region, 
scale: 30, 
crs: 'EPSG:4326’, 
maxPixels: 1e13, 
folder: 'GEE’ 
\});

image: typically refers to a single raster dataset
description: name type of export
region: your area
scale: resolution of data 
crs: coordinate reference system for the output image
maxPixels: the numbers of pixels in the exported image
folder: set automatically the folder in Google Drive

slides.title: Exporting Data
slides.text:
Raster to Asset

Use Export.image.toAsset () to download your imagery data sets.

```js
Export.image.toAsset({
image: medianImage,            description: "Bhutan",                    assetId: "Bhutan",                    region: studyArea.bounds(), 
scale:10,                    maxPixels:1e13
});
```

image: typically refers to a single raster dataset
description: name type of export
region: your area
scale: resolution of data 
assetId: you asset ID in Google earth engine account 
maxPixels: the numbers of pixels in the exported image
folder: set automatically the folder in Google Drive

slides.title: Exporting Data
slides.text:
SHP to Google Drive

Use Export.table.toDrive() to download your imagery data sets.

Export.table.toDrive(\{ 
collection: features, 
description:'features’, 
folder: 'GEE_’, 
fileFormat: 'SHP’ 
\});

collection: typically refers to type of data 
description: name type of export
folder: set automatically the folder in Google Drive
fileFormat:  Type of format

slides.title: Exporting Data
slides.text:
SHP to Asset

Use Export.table.toAsset() to download your imagery data sets.

```js
// Export an ee.FeatureCollection Export.table.toAsset({   collection: features,
 description: 'exportToTableAssetExample',   assetId: 'exampleAssetId', });
```

collection: typically refers to type of data 
description: name type of export
assetId: you asset ID in Google earth engine account
